title: Sharp Sobolev mapping for the decaying Airy kernel
source_hypothesis: Small compact base/conic patch around strict glancing; real phases theta,zeta of degrees 1,2/3 with invertible boundary mixed generator, exact boundary Airy argument and negative normal Airy derivative; classical finite matrix amplitudes of orders 0,-1/3. The lower bound additionally retains an interior branch and invertible leading g with h vanishing at the boundary.
